verdict.rationale: Microsoft Teams documents dedicated Export APIs (ms-teams-docs-13) that let admins export 1:1, group chat, meeting, and channel messages, including capturing deleted messages up to 21 days later (ms-teams-docs-14), which directly matches the compliance-export story with policy-gated access to private conversations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the export workflow, and explicit detail on output format/schema and role-based policy gating beyond the docs summary.
